Question 3
?

Determine the Cartesian equation of the circle

x=2cos⁡θ−1,y=2sin⁡θ+4,0≤θ<2π.

a
 (x−1)2+(y+4)2=4
b
 (x+1)2+(y−4)2=2
c
 (x+1)2+(y−4)2=4
d
 (x−1)2+(y+4)2=2
e
 (x−1)2+(y+4)2=8
